description: This Java class defines ModuleConditionalResource, which specifies resources loaded conditionally in OpenMRS modules based on versioning and dependencies. It includes properties such as the resource path, required OpenMRS platform version, and modules with versions, along with standard methods like getters, setters, equals, hashCode, and toString. It also contains a nested static class ModuleAndVersion representing module ID and version.

classes.name: ModuleConditionalResource
classes.description: Represents a resource that can be conditionally loaded based on OpenMRS version and modules.

classes.name: ModuleConditionalResource.ModuleAndVersion
classes.description: Encapsulates a module's ID and version used within ModuleConditionalResource for conditional resource loading.

methods.name: getOpenmrsPlatformVersion
methods.description: Returns the required OpenMRS platform version.

methods.name: setOpenmrsPlatformVersion
methods.description: Sets the required OpenMRS platform version.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Returns the list of modules with their versions.

methods.name: setModules
methods.description: Sets the list of modules with their versions.
